questions.q: Select the synonym of the word 'Gregarious'.
questions.x: 'Gregarious' means sociable. 'Solitary' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q: Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to: LAVISH
questions.x: 'Lavish' is the opposite of 'Stingy'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Lavish'.

questions.q: Choose the one word that can be substituted for: 'Money paid regularly to a student or trainee'
questions.x: 'Stipend' means money paid regularly to a student or trainee.

questions.q: The union demanded that the management ____ the decision immediately.
questions.x: Correct answer: withdraw. The subjunctive form (base verb) is used after 'demand that'.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
No sooner did he sign / the agreement when / the union called off the strike.
o: the union called off the strike.
questions.x: The error is in part (b): 'the agreement when'. 'No sooner' pairs with 'than'.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
Unless he works hard, / he will not / succeeds in the examination.
questions.x: The error is in part (c): 'succeeds in the examination'. After 'will not', use the base form: 'succeed'.

questions.q: Select the antonym of the word 'Rigid'.
questions.x: 'Rigid' is the opposite of 'Pliable'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Rigid'.

questions.q: What does the phrase 'To call a spade a spade' mean?
questions.x: 'To call a spade a spade' means: to speak plainly and frankly.

questions.q: Choose the option that best expresses the meaning of the idiom: 'To read between the lines'
questions.x: 'To read between the lines' means: to understand the hidden meaning.

questions.q: Choose the word that is most nearly SAME in meaning to: FRUGAL
questions.x: 'Frugal' means thrifty. 'Lavish' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q: According to the passage, data protection is fundamentally about:
o: Respect for the person whose information is collected
Collecting as much data as possible
questions.x: Answer: 'Respect for the person whose information is collected'. The opening sentence makes this point. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Data protection is not only about secrecy; it is about respect. When an organisation collects a person's information, it takes on a duty to use it only for the stated purpose, keep it safe and delete it when no longer needed. Leaks erode confidence in digital services, especially among first-time users. Clear consent, minimal collection and prompt reporting of breaches are the foundations of a trustworthy system.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT listed as a foundation of a trustworthy system?
questions.x: Answer: 'Maximum data collection'. The passage stresses minimal, not maximum, collection. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Data protection is not only about secrecy; it is about respect. When an organisation collects a person's information, it takes on a duty to use it only for the stated purpose, keep it safe and delete it when no longer needed. Leaks erode confidence in digital services, especially among first-time users. Clear consent, minimal collection and prompt reporting of breaches are the foundations of a trustworthy system.

questions.q:
Consider the following:
Assertion (A): Lord Curzon partitioned Bengal in 1905.
Reason (R): Bengal was the nerve centre of Indian nationalism and the partition aimed to weaken it.
Select the correct answer:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.x: A is true and R is true; R correctly explains A. R gives the political motive that historians accept as the real reason.

questions.q: Sree Narayana Guru is associated with the founding of:
questions.x: Sree Narayana Guru founded the Sree Narayana Dharma Paripalana Yogam.

questions.q: Who is known as the 'Grand Old Man of India'?
questions.x: He was also the first Indian elected to the British House of Commons (1892).

questions.q: Who first addressed Gandhi as 'Father of the Nation' in a radio broadcast from Singapore (1944)?
questions.x: Correct answer: Subhas Chandra Bose. Bose sought Gandhi's blessings for the INA's struggle.

questions.q: The 'Wardha Scheme of Basic Education' (1937) proposed by Gandhi emphasised:
o: Education through a craft in the mother tongue
questions.x: Correct answer: Education through a craft in the mother tongue. The Zakir Hussain Committee worked out the details.

questions.q: The Lucknow Pact (1916) was an agreement between:
o: The Congress and the Muslim League
questions.x: The Congress accepted separate electorates; it marked Hindu–Muslim unity.

questions.q: The Government of India Act, 1919 introduced bicameral legislature at the Centre and:
questions.x: Correct answer: Dyarchy in the provinces. It also extended communal representation to Sikhs and others.

questions.q: The book 'Gulamgiri' was written by:
questions.x: 'Gulamgiri' was written by Jyotirao Phule.

questions.q: Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt threw bombs in the Central Legislative Assembly in 1929 to protest against:
o: The Public Safety Bill and Trade Disputes Bill
questions.x: Correct answer: The Public Safety Bill and Trade Disputes Bill. They courted arrest and raised slogans like 'Inquilab Zindabad'.

questions.q: Choose the correct year for this event: the Kakori train action took place.
questions.x: The Kakori train action took place in 1925. Fix this date on your 1857–1947 timeline along with the events immediately before and after it.

questions.q: World AIDS Day is observed on:
questions.x: World AIDS Day: 1 December.

questions.q: Neeraj Chopra won India's first-ever gold at the World Athletics Championships in:
questions.x: Correct answer: 2023 (Budapest). He had won Olympic gold at Tokyo 2020.

questions.q: Which Indian city was declared India's first 'World Heritage City' by UNESCO in 2017?
questions.x: Correct answer: Ahmedabad. Jaipur was inscribed in 2019.

questions.q: The headquarters of the World Meteorological Organization is located in:
questions.x: World Meteorological Organization: headquartered in Geneva.

questions.q: 'Urban heat island' effect refers to:
o: Cities being significantly warmer than surrounding rural areas
questions.x: Correct answer: Cities being significantly warmer than surrounding rural areas. Concrete surfaces and reduced vegetation cause it.

questions.q: India's first 'Gen-AI' focused national programme for public services and language technology, 'BHASHINI', aims to:
o: Create a national social media app
Provide AI-based translation across Indian languages
questions.x: Correct answer: Provide AI-based translation across Indian languages. It is part of the National Language Translation Mission.

questions.q: In 2025, Sanae Takaichi became the first woman to hold the office of:
questions.x: Correct answer: Prime Minister of Japan. She took office in October 2025.

questions.q: India's 'Carbon Credit Trading Scheme' was notified in 2023 under the:
questions.x: Correct answer: Energy Conservation Act, 2001. The Bureau of Energy Efficiency administers the compliance mechanism.

questions.q: 'Mission Indradhanush' (2014) is related to:
o: Full immunisation of children and pregnant women
questions.x: Correct answer: Full immunisation of children and pregnant women. Intensified Mission Indradhanush has run several rounds.

questions.q: The 'National Quantum Mission' approved in 2023 aims to:
o: Develop quantum computing, communication, sensing and materials
questions.x: Correct answer: Develop quantum computing, communication, sensing and materials. It runs from 2023–24 to 2030–31.

questions.q: Article 338 of the Constitution of India deals with:
o: Protection of certain rights regarding freedom of speech, assembly, association, movement, residence and profession
Original jurisdiction of the Supreme Court
Facilities for instruction in mother tongue at primary stage
questions.x: Article 338: National Commission for Scheduled Castes.

questions.q: The Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act was enacted in:
questions.x: The first Lokpal, Justice Pinaki Chandra Ghose, was appointed in 2019.

questions.q: In Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India (1978), the Supreme Court held that the procedure under Article 21 must be:
questions.x: Correct answer: Fair, just and reasonable. It read Articles 14, 19 and 21 together ('golden triangle').

questions.q: The President can be removed from office by:
o: Impeachment by Parliament for violation of the Constitution
A no-confidence motion in the Lok Sabha
questions.x: Impeachment under Article 61 requires a two-thirds majority of the total membership of each House.

questions.q: The Rajya Sabha can delay a Money Bill by a maximum of:
questions.x: It may only make recommendations within 14 days.

questions.q: Article 169 of the Constitution of India deals with:
o: Remedies for enforcement of Fundamental Rights (writs by the Supreme Court)
Power of Parliament to legislate on a State List matter in the national interest
Power of Parliament to amend the Constitution
Abolition or creation of Legislative Councils in States
questions.x: Article 169: Abolition or creation of Legislative Councils in States.

questions.q: Article 20 of the Constitution of India deals with:
o: Failure of constitutional machinery in States (President's Rule)
Prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth
Protection in respect of conviction for offences (double jeopardy, self-incrimination)
questions.x: Article 20: Protection in respect of conviction for offences (double jeopardy, self-incrimination).

questions.q: "Powers, authority and responsibilities of Municipalities (18 subjects)" is the subject matter of which Schedule of the Constitution?
questions.x: It is the Twelfth Schedule.

questions.q: The Constituent Assembly was constituted under the scheme of the:
questions.x: Members were indirectly elected by provincial assemblies as per the Cabinet Mission Plan.

questions.q: 'NOTA' was introduced in Indian elections following the Supreme Court's judgment in:
questions.x: Correct answer: PUCL v. Union of India (2013). NOTA was first used in the 2013 State Assembly elections.

questions.q: A fixed deposit pays 10% per annum while inflation is 6%. Using the Fisher approximation, the real rate of interest is about:
questions.x:
Fisher approximation: real rate ≈ nominal rate − inflation = 10 − 6 = 4%.
(Exact: (1.10/1.06 − 1) × 100 ≈ 3.77%.)

questions.q: 'Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission' aims to create:
o: A digital health ecosystem with health IDs (ABHA)
questions.x: Correct answer: A digital health ecosystem with health IDs (ABHA). ABHA numbers link health records digitally.

questions.q: The main thrust of the Third Five-Year Plan (1961–66) was:
o: Growth with stability and progressive achievement of self-reliance
Rapid industrialisation with heavy industries, based on the Mahalanobis model
Doubling per capita income in ten years; monitorable targets
Self-reliant and self-generating economy; disrupted by wars and drought, followed by plan holidays
questions.x: Third Five-Year Plan (1961–66): Self-reliant and self-generating economy; disrupted by wars and drought, followed by plan holidays.

questions.q:
In which year did the following happen?
The Life Insurance Corporation of India was formed.
questions.x: The Life Insurance Corporation of India was formed in 1956.

questions.q: The PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (2024) provides:
o: Subsidy for rooftop solar to provide up to 300 units of free electricity monthly to households
questions.x: Correct answer: Subsidy for rooftop solar to provide up to 300 units of free electricity monthly to households. It targets one crore households.

questions.q: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code requires corporate insolvency resolution to be completed ordinarily within:
questions.x: The original limit was 180 days extendable by 90; amended to 330 days including litigation.

questions.q: 'Purchasing Power Parity' is used to:
o: Compare living standards across countries by adjusting for price differences
questions.x: Correct answer: Compare living standards across countries by adjusting for price differences. On PPP basis India is the third largest economy.

questions.q: Kisan Credit Cards (introduced in 1998) primarily provide:
o: Timely short-term credit for cultivation and allied needs
questions.x: Correct answer: Timely short-term credit for cultivation and allied needs. KCC was later extended to animal husbandry and fisheries.

questions.q: The Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) allows banks to borrow overnight from the RBI by dipping into:
o: Their SLR securities up to a limit
questions.x: Correct answer: Their SLR securities up to a limit. MSF is the ceiling of the LAF corridor.

questions.q: India is the world's largest recipient of:
questions.x: According to the World Bank, India received about US$ 129 billion in remittances in 2024 — the highest of any country.

questions.q: Goods withdrawn by the proprietor for personal use are recorded as:
o: Drawings A/c Dr. To Sales A/c
Drawings A/c Dr. To Purchases A/c
Capital A/c Dr. To Cash A/c
Purchases A/c Dr. To Drawings A/c
questions.x: Correct answer: Drawings A/c Dr. To Purchases A/c. Goods taken reduce purchases (at cost) and increase drawings.

questions.q: A bill of exchange is drawn by:
questions.x: Correct answer: The creditor (drawer) on the debtor (drawee). The drawer orders the drawee to pay; the drawee accepts it.

questions.q: The profits of a firm for the last 4 years were ₹58,000, ₹72,000, ₹50,000, ₹26,000. Goodwill is to be valued at 2.5 years' purchase of the average profit. Goodwill is:

Match the account with its type:
Account:
A. Furniture A/c
B. Wages A/c
C. Outstanding Rent A/c
D. Bank of Baroda A/c
Type:
1. Representative personal account
2. Real account
3. Artificial personal account
4. Nominal account
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.x:
Correct matching — A (Furniture A/c) → 2 (Real account); B (Wages A/c) → 4 (Nominal account); C (Outstanding Rent A/c) → 1 (Representative personal account); D (Bank of Baroda A/c) → 3 (Artificial personal account).
Outstanding/prepaid accounts represent persons; banks and companies are artificial persons.

questions.q: A partner withdrew ₹2,000 at the end of every month during the year. Interest on drawings is charged at 6% p.a. The interest on drawings is:
questions.x:
Total drawings = 12 × 2,000 = ₹24,000.
Average period for monthly drawings made at the end of each month = 5.5 months.
Interest = 24,000 × 6% × 5.5/12 = ₹660.

questions.q: Matching expenses with the revenues they help to earn in the same period is the:
questions.x: Correct answer: Matching concept. It underlies accruals, prepaid and outstanding adjustments.

questions.q: A delivery van is purchased for ₹4,15,000 and ₹3,000 is spent on its installation. Its estimated useful life is 4 years with a residual value of ₹16,000. Annual depreciation under the Straight Line Method is:
questions.x:
SLM depreciation = (Cost + installation − residual value) / useful life.
= (4,15,000 + 3,000 − 16,000) / 4 = 4,02,000 / 4 = ₹1,00,500 per year.
Installation is capitalised as part of cost (AS 10 / Ind AS 16).

questions.q: Opening inventory is ₹80,000, closing inventory is ₹50,000 and cost of goods sold for the year is ₹3,90,000. The inventory turnover ratio is:
questions.x:
Average inventory = (80,000 + 50,000) / 2 = ₹65,000.
Inventory turnover = COGS / Average inventory = 3,90,000 / 65,000 = 6 times.

questions.q: A product sells at ₹155 with a variable cost of ₹120 per unit. Fixed costs are ₹2,13,500. The break-even sales (in ₹) are:
questions.x:
P/V ratio = Contribution/Sales = 35/155 = 22.58%.
BEP sales = Fixed cost / P/V ratio = 2,13,500 / 0.2258 = ₹9,45,500.

questions.q: Payment of dividend by a company is classified in the cash flow statement as:
questions.x: Dividends paid and debenture interest paid are financing outflows (for non-financial companies).

questions.q: Prepaid expenses are shown in the balance sheet as:
questions.x: Correct answer: Current assets. They represent future benefit already paid for.

questions.q: The current ratio of a company is 3 : 1 and its working capital is ₹2,60,000. Its current assets amount to:
questions.x:
Let current liabilities = x. Then current assets = 3x and working capital = 3x − x = 2x.
2x = 2,60,000 → x = ₹1,30,000.
Current assets = 3 × 1,30,000 = ₹3,90,000.

questions.q: P and Q share profits in the ratio 3 : 1. They admit R for a 1/5 share, which R acquires from P and Q in their existing ratio. The new profit-sharing ratio of P, Q and R is:
Treating capital expenditure as revenue expenditure is an example of an:
questions.x: It violates accounting principles but does not disturb the trial balance.

questions.q: Under the IR Code, a trade union having what minimum membership among workers on the muster roll is recognised as the sole negotiating union?
questions.x: Section 14: a union with 51% or more of the workers as members is recognised as the sole negotiating union.

questions.q: Quality circles, a form of employee involvement, originated in:
o: United States, by F. W. Taylor
questions.x: Quality circles — small voluntary groups solving work problems — were popularised by Ishikawa in Japan in the 1960s.

questions.q: A woman worker is asked to work from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. in a garment unit. Under the OSH Code, this is permissible only if:
o: She is above 45 years of age
She consents and the employer provides prescribed safety, transport and other conditions
Never, as women cannot work at night
questions.x: Night work for women requires consent and compliance with safety and other conditions prescribed by the appropriate government.

questions.q: Annual leave with wages under the OSH Code is earned at the rate of one day for every how many days of work performed by an adult worker?
questions.x: An adult worker earns one day's leave for every twenty days of work in the previous calendar year.

questions.q:
Consider the following:
Assertion (A): The Labour Codes extend minimum wage protection to workers in the unorganised sector as well.
Reason (R): The Minimum Wages Act, 1948 applied only to scheduled employments.
Select the correct answer:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.x: A is true and R is true; R correctly explains A. Under the 1948 Act, minimum wages applied only to employments listed in the schedule; the Code on Wages universalises minimum wages to all employees, which explains the extension.

questions.q: The 'wage fund theory' of wages is associated with:
questions.x: The wage fund theory held that wages depend on a fixed fund of capital set aside for paying labour, divided by the number of workers.

questions.q: The penalty for paying an employee less than the amount due under the Code on Wages, for a first offence, is a fine of up to:
questions.x: Section 54(1)(a) prescribes a fine up to ₹50,000; repeat offences within five years attract imprisonment up to three months or a fine up to ₹1 lakh or both.

questions.q: 'Informal employment' in labour statistics broadly refers to workers who:
o: Are self-employed professionals with high incomes
Lack written contracts, paid leave and social security benefits
questions.x: Informality is about absence of social security and job security, whether in the formal or informal sector.

questions.q: John T. Dunlop's 'systems theory' of industrial relations (1958) identifies which three actors?
o: Workers and their organisations, managers and their organisations, and government agencies
questions.x: Dunlop's Industrial Relations Systems sees the three actors operating within technological, market and power contexts, bound by a shared ideology.

questions.q: The ILO's 'Global Wage Report' and 'World Employment and Social Outlook' are examples of:
questions.x: Correct answer: Periodic ILO flagship publications. Both are ILO flagship reports on wages and labour market trends.

questions.q: An 'International Worker' under the EPF Scheme is broadly:
o: Only employees of the UN in India
A worker who travels abroad for a holiday
An Indian employee working abroad in a country with an SSA, or a foreign national working in a covered Indian establishment
Any Indian with a foreign bank account
questions.x: Special provisions (since 2008) cover international workers, including foreign nationals in India and Indians working in SSA countries.

questions.q: Hind Mazdoor Sabha (HMS) was formed in 1948 largely by leaders associated with:
questions.x: HMS was founded by socialists such as Ashok Mehta and Basawon Singh after leaving the Congress.

questions.q: Identify the year of enactment of the Payment of Wages Act.
questions.x: The Payment of Wages Act was enacted in 1936.

questions.q: The 'marginal productivity theory' of wages states that wages tend to equal:
o: The wage fund divided by the number of workers
The value of the marginal product of labour
The residual after paying rent, interest and profit
questions.x: Associated with J. B. Clark, it holds that in competitive markets wages equal the marginal revenue product of labour.

questions.q: Under the Maternity Benefit Act as amended in 2017, a woman who legally adopts a child below three months of age is entitled to maternity benefit for:
questions.x: Adopting mothers (child below three months) and commissioning mothers get 12 weeks from the date the child is handed over.

questions.q: The Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) is a pension scheme for unorganised workers aged:
o: 18–40 years with monthly income up to ₹15,000
questions.x: PM-SYM (2019) is a voluntary, contributory scheme assuring ₹3,000 monthly pension after 60, with matching government contribution; LIC is fund manager.

questions.q: ESIC's 'SPREE 2025' initiative refers to:
o: A one-time scheme to promote registration of unregistered employers and employees without past inspections or demands
questions.x: SPREE 2025 (Scheme for Promotion of Registration of Employers and Employees) allowed voluntary registration with no demand for earlier periods.

questions.q:
Consider the following:
Assertion (A): Targeted schemes may suffer from exclusion errors.
Reason (R): Identifying beneficiaries requires information on income and assets that is often incomplete for informal workers.
Select the correct answer:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.x: A is true and R is true; R correctly explains A. Poor information on informal incomes causes eligible people to be left out, which explains exclusion errors.

questions.q: The Central Board of Trustees, EPF comprises representatives of:
o: Central and State Governments, employers and employees
questions.x: It includes government, employer and employee representatives (10 each of employers and employees) besides ex-officio members.

questions.q: Under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, 'benchmark disability' means a disability of at least:
questions.x: Persons with 40% or more of a specified disability are entitled to reservation and certain benefits.

questions.q: Employees who join EPF after 1 September 2014 with wages above ₹15,000 are:
questions.x: New entrants drawing above the ceiling are excluded from EPS (their entire employer share goes to EPF if they join EPF).

questions.q: An eligible employee earns ₹8,000 per month. The notified minimum wage for the employment is ₹6,000 per month. If the establishment declares bonus at 10%, the annual bonus payable is (statutory computation):
questions.x:
For computing bonus, salary is capped at ₹7,000 or the minimum wage, whichever is higher: max(7,000, 6,000) = ₹7,000.
Salary for computation = min(8,000, 7,000) = ₹7,000.
Annual bonus = 7,000 × 12 × 10% = ₹8,400. Bonus must lie between 8.33% and 20%.

questions.q: Which of the following laws is NOT subsumed in the Code on Social Security?
questions.x: Correct answer: Payment of Bonus Act, 1965. Payment of Bonus is part of the Code on Wages.

questions.q: A 'defined benefit' pension plan is one in which:
o: The contribution is fixed and the pension depends on returns
The pension amount is fixed by a formula, and the sponsor bears the investment risk
questions.x: EPS 1995 and the old pension scheme are DB; NPS and EPF are defined contribution.

questions.q: For seasonal establishments, gratuity is payable at the rate of:
questions.x: Correct answer: 7 days' wages for each season. Seasonal employees get seven days' wages for each season.

questions.q: Under the Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995, a member retires at 58 with pensionable salary of ₹9,000 and pensionable service of 14 years (including any weightage). The monthly member pension is:
questions.x:
Monthly pension = (Pensionable salary × Pensionable service) / 70
= (9,000 × 14) / 70 = ₹1,800.
Pensionable salary is the average of the last 60 months' wages (subject to the ₹15,000 ceiling), and the minimum pension is ₹1,000.

questions.q: Which section of the EPF & MP Act provides for the constitution of the Central Board of Trustees?
questions.x: Section 5A constitutes the CBT; Section 5B the Executive Committee.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. PMSBY covers death due to any cause.
2. PMJJBY covers death due to any cause.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.x:
Statement 1 is incorrect; Statement 2 is correct.
PMJJBY is life insurance (any cause); PMSBY covers only accidental death and disability.

questions.q: CaO (calcium oxide) is commonly known as:
questions.x: CaO (calcium oxide) is quicklime.

questions.q: A rocket's upward motion is best explained by:
questions.x: Exhaust gases pushed down produce an equal and opposite upward thrust.

questions.q: Water has its maximum density at:
questions.x: This anomalous behaviour of water is important for aquatic ecosystems.

questions.q: In a relational database, a column that uniquely identifies each row is the:
questions.x: A foreign key links to the primary key of another table.

questions.q: The causative agent of typhoid is:
questions.x: Typhoid: Salmonella Typhi (bacterium).

questions.q: A anemometer is used to measure:
questions.x: Anemometer: Wind speed.

questions.q: The acid present in the human stomach is:
questions.x: It aids digestion and kills microbes; antacids neutralise excess acid.

questions.q: Which layer of the atmosphere reflects radio waves back to Earth?
questions.x: Correct answer: Ionosphere. It is part of the thermosphere.

questions.q: Which network topology connects all devices to a central hub or switch?
questions.x: Correct answer: Star. Failure of the central device stops the network.

questions.q: Linux is an example of:
questions.x: Correct answer: Open-source operating system. Its kernel was created by Linus Torvalds in 1991.

questions.q: A 'URL' such as https://www.epfindia.gov.in has 'epfindia.gov.in' as its:
questions.x: Correct answer: Domain name. 'https' is the protocol.

questions.q: In computing, 'OCR' stands for:
questions.x: OCR = Optical Character Recognition.

questions.q: A sum of money lent at simple interest amounts to ₹5,800 in 2 years and to ₹7,400 in 6 years. The rate of interest per annum is:
A and B start a business investing ₹15,000 and ₹30,000 for a year. Out of a profit of ₹5,400, B gets:
questions.x:
Profit is shared in the ratio of capital × time.
A: 15,000×12, B: 30,000×12 → 1 : 2.
B's share = 2/3 × 5,400 = ₹3,600.

questions.q: In how many ways can the letters of the word 'COMPANY' be arranged so that all the vowels always come together?
questions.x:
Vowels: O, A; consonants: C, M, P, N, Y.
Treat the vowels as one block → 6 units → 720 arrangements (all letters are distinct).
Vowels inside the block: 2 ways (all letters are distinct).
Total = 720 × 2 = 1,440.

questions.q:
Claims settled (in thousand) — 2017: 115  |  2018: 155  |  2019: 215  |  2020: 240  |  2021: 285.
What is the percentage change from 2018 to 2020?
questions.x:
Change = 240 − 155 = 85 on a base of 155 (earlier year).
% change = 85/155 × 100 = 54.84% → 54.84% increase.

questions.q: What is the unit digit of 33^52?
questions.x:
Unit digit depends only on 3. Powers of 3 repeat with cycle 4: 3, 9, 7, 1.
52 ÷ 4 leaves remainder 0 (treated as 4) → use position 4 of the cycle → 1.

questions.q: Find the next term of the series: 52, 67, 84, 103, 124, ?
questions.x: Terms are 7²+3, 8²+3, … so the next is 12² + 3 = 147.

questions.q: A bag has 3 white and 8 black balls. Two balls are drawn at random together. What is the probability that at least one of them is white?
questions.x:
P(at least one white) = 1 − P(both black).
P(both black) = C(8,2)/C(11,2) = 28/55.
Required = 1 − 28/55 = 27/55.

questions.q: The monthly incomes of P and Q are in the ratio 7 : 6 and their monthly expenditures are in the ratio 6 : 5. If each of them saves ₹4,500 a month, P's monthly income is:
questions.x:
Let incomes = 7k, 6k and expenditures = 6m, 5m.
7k − 6m = 6k − 5m = 4,500 → 1k = 1m.
Solving gives k = 4,500, m = 4,500.
P's income = 7 × 4,500 = ₹31,500 (check: ₹31,500 − ₹27,000 = ₹4,500).

questions.q: Find the volume of a cylindrical water tank of radius 10.5 m and height 28 m. (Take π = 22/7)
questions.x:
V = πr²h = (22/7) × 10.5 × 10.5 × 28 = 9702 m³.
(Curved surface 2πrh would be 1848 m² — a common mix-up.)

questions.q: What is the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 2:45?
questions.x:
Angle = |30H − 5.5M| = |30×2 − 5.5×45| = |60 − 247.5| = 187.5°.
Since this exceeds 180°, the smaller angle = 360 − 187.5 = 172.5°.
(The minute hand gains 5.5° per minute over the hour hand.)

questions.q: The average age of 36 trainees in a batch is 10 years. When the instructor's age is also included, the average rises by 1 year. The instructor's age is:
questions.x:
Total of trainees = 36 × 10 = 360.
With instructor: 37 × 11 = 407.
Instructor = 407 − 360 = 47 years.

questions.q: Find the median of the absentee counts of a unit: 19, 62, 58, 17, 11, 93, 78, 37, 41, 22.
questions.x:
Arrange in order: 11, 17, 19, 22, 37, 41, 58, 62, 78, 93.
n = 10 (even) → median = average of the 5th and 6th values = (37 + 41)/2 = 39.

questions.q: The ratio of the present ages of P and Q is 8 : 9. After 14 years, the ratio will become 10 : 11. What is P's present age?
A courier van travels from town P to town Q at 60 km/h and returns along the same road at 90 km/h. The average speed for the whole journey is:
questions.x:
For equal distances, average speed = 2uv/(u + v) (harmonic mean), not (u + v)/2.
= 2 × 60 × 90 / (60 + 90) = 10800/150 = 72 km/h.
